cards.name: Luck Bobblehead
cards.oracleText:
{T}: Add one mana of any color.
{1}, {T}: Roll X six-sided dice, where X is the number of Bobbleheads you control. Create a tapped Treasure token for each even result. If you rolled 6 exactly seven times, you win the game.

cards.name: Lucky Clover
cards.oracleText: Whenever you cast an Adventure instant or sorcery spell, copy it. You may choose new targets for the copy.

cards.name: Lucky Offering
cards.oracleText: Destroy target artifact with mana value 3 or less. You gain 3 life.

cards.name: Lucky the Pizza Dog
cards.oracleText:
Whenever you cast a Cat, Dog, or Hero spell, create a Food token. (It's an artifact with "{2}, {T}, Sacrifice this token: You gain 3 life.")
At the beginning of each end step, if you gained life this turn, put a +1/+1 counter on Lucky.
